description: A retail pharmacy invoice or cash memo from an Indian medical store.

pharmacy_name.description: Trading name of the pharmacy, printed in the letterhead.

drug_licence_number.description: The drug licence number printed in the letterhead or footer.

gstin.description: The fifteen character GST identification number of the pharmacy.

invoice_number.description: The invoice or bill number for this sale.

invoice_date.description: The date of sale, exactly as printed on the invoice.

customer_name.description: Name of the buyer, printed in the patient or customer block.

prescribing_doctor.description: Name of the prescribing doctor, where the invoice records one.

payment_mode.description: How the bill was settled, as printed near the total.

subtotal_amount.description: Total of all line items before tax and rounding, in rupees.

tax_amount.description: Total GST charged on the invoice, in rupees.

discount_amount.description: Total discount applied to the invoice, in rupees.

total_amount.description: Net amount payable after tax, discount and rounding, in rupees.

line_items.description: One entry per row of the medicine table on the invoice.

items.description: A single medicine row from the invoice table.

item_name.description: The medicine name and strength exactly as printed on the row.

batch_number.description: The batch number printed on the row.

expiry.description: The expiry date printed on the row, usually as month and year.

hsn_code.description: The HSN code printed on the row, where the invoice carries one.

quantity.description: Number of units or strips sold on this row.

mrp.description: Maximum retail price per unit printed on the row, in rupees.

rate.description: Rate actually charged per unit on this row, in rupees.

gst_percent.description: GST rate applied to this row, as a percentage.

amount.description: Amount charged for this row, in rupees.
